id: 17_Safety measures of microbiology lab General safety PPE GLP proper training labor
title: 微生物实验室的通用安全措施（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/17_Safety measures of microbiology lab General safety PPE GLP proper training labor.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/17_Safety measures of microbiology lab General safety PPE GLP proper training labor（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 危害来自微生物、化学品和设备
points.K2: 穿实验服、戴手套、穿对鞋
points.K3: 有危险材料，戴护目镜或面屏
points.K5: 接触微生物后、离开前，洗手
points.S1: 开工前、收工后，台面消毒
points.S2: 实验服：专用存放，先消毒再洗
points.S3: 近视眼镜不能代替护目镜

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室里，身边是手套、口罩和黄色废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a microbiology lab next to a box of gloves, a face mask and a yellow waste bag with a biohazard sign.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到生物安全课。
overlay: 微生物实验室的通用安全措施

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起三根手指，身旁三个图标：手套、洗手、讲台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers beside three icons: gloves, washing hands, and a classroom podium.
shots.narration: 今天讲三件事：防护、习惯、培训。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰第一次做细菌涂片，袖子卷着，没戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student prepares to make a bacterial smear for the first time, sleeves rolled up and no goggles on.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次上微生物实验课。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 台面上堆满书包、水杯和培养皿
shots.prompt_en: His bench is cluttered with a backpack, a water bottle and stacks of culture dishes.
shots.narration: 台面上书包、水杯、培养皿堆在一起。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研走过来，指了指他的台面和袖子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points at his bench and his rolled-up sleeves.
shots.narration: 小研说：先别动，一样一样来。

shots.section_title: 危害来自微生物、化学品和设备
shots.scene: 三个图标：细菌、化学瓶、离心机
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a bacterium, a chemical bottle with a hazard pictogram, and a centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物实验室的危险，来自三方面：
overlay: 危害来自微生物、化学品和设备

shots.section_title: 危害来自微生物、化学品和设备
shots.scene: 培养皿、消毒剂瓶、高压灭菌器排成一行
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish, a disinfectant bottle and an autoclave in a row, each with a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 活的微生物、消毒剂试剂、各种仪器。

shots.section_title: 危害来自微生物、化学品和设备
shots.scene: 盾牌罩住整个实验台
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon covering a whole lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 所以安全措施，一样都不能少。

shots.section_title: 穿实验服、戴手套、穿对鞋
shots.scene: 阿杰放下袖子，穿好长袖实验服，扣上扣子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rolls down his sleeves, puts on a long-sleeved lab coat and fastens every button.
shots.narration: 第一，穿好实验服，扣好扣子。
overlay: 穿实验服、戴手套、穿对鞋

shots.section_title: 穿实验服、戴手套、穿对鞋
shots.scene: 阿杰戴上一次性手套，检查有没有破洞
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on disposable gloves and checks them for holes.
shots.narration: 戴上手套，先看有没有破损。

shots.section_title: 穿实验服、戴手套、穿对鞋
shots.scene: 不露脚面的鞋打勾，拖鞋凉鞋打叉
shots.prompt_en: Closed-toe shoes with a green check; slippers and sandals crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿不露脚面的鞋，防洒防砸。

shots.section_title: 穿实验服、戴手套、穿对鞋
shots.scene: 手套脏了破了，换新手套的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons showing a torn glove being removed and a new glove being put on. No people.
shots.narration: 手套破了、污染了，马上换。

shots.section_title: 有危险材料，戴护目镜或面屏
shots.scene: 护目镜和面屏两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a pair of safety goggles and a full face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，操作危险材料时护住眼睛和脸。
overlay: 有危险材料，戴护目镜或面屏

shots.section_title: 有危险材料，戴护目镜或面屏
shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，在安全柜旁倒消毒液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears goggles while pouring disinfectant into a container beside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 倒消毒剂、可能溅洒时，戴护目镜；

shots.section_title: 有危险材料，戴护目镜或面屏
shots.scene: 面屏挡住飞溅的液滴示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of droplets splashing toward a face and being blocked by a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 溅洒风险更大时，加戴面屏。

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不化妆
shots.scene: 水杯、零食、口红三个图标都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a cup, a snack and a lipstick, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，实验室里不吃、不喝、不化妆。

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不化妆
shots.scene: 阿杰把水杯和书包放到门外储物柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves his water bottle and backpack to a locker outside the lab door.
shots.narration: 水杯、零食、书包，放在门外。

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不化妆
shots.scene: 手到嘴、手到脸的虚线箭头被打断
shots.prompt_en: Dashed arrows from a hand to the mouth and from a hand to the face, cut by red breaks. No people.
shots.narration: 管住手，就切断了病菌进嘴的路。

shots.section_title: 接触微生物后、离开前，洗手
shots.scene: 阿杰摘下手套，扔进生物危害废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off his gloves and drops them into a waste bin with a biohazard sign.
shots.narration: 第四，接触微生物后，摘手套洗手。
overlay: 接触微生物后、离开前，洗手

shots.section_title: 接触微生物后、离开前，洗手
shots.scene: 洗手池前搓洗手心、手背、指缝、指尖的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of hand-washing steps at a sink: palms, backs of hands, between fingers, and fingertips. No people.
shots.narration: 用洗手液，手心手背指缝都搓到，

shots.section_title: 接触微生物后、离开前，洗手
shots.scene: 阿杰在门口洗手后离开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands at the sink by the door before leaving the lab.
shots.narration: 离开实验室前，再洗一次。

shots.section_title: 工作区干净整齐
shots.scene: 杂乱台面和整洁台面左右对比
shots.prompt_en: A split image: a cluttered bench on the left with a red X, and a clean, tidy bench on the right with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，工作区保持干净整齐。

shots.section_title: 工作区干净整齐
shots.scene: 台面上只留需要的培养皿和接种环
shots.prompt_en: A tidy bench with only the culture dishes, an inoculating loop and a burner needed for the task. No people.
shots.narration: 台面只放这次要用的东西，

shots.section_title: 工作区干净整齐
shots.scene: 过道和安全柜前空空的，没有纸箱
shots.prompt_en: A clear walkway and an uncluttered area in front of a biological safety cabinet, with no boxes on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 通道和设备前不堆杂物。

shots.section_title: 人人培训：规程和应急
shots.scene: 王老师给新生上安全课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a lab safety class to new students in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 第六，每个人都要接受培训。

shots.section_title: 人人培训：规程和应急
shots.scene: 操作规程手册和应急预案两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a blank procedure manual and a blank emergency plan with a first aid cross. No people.
shots.narration: 既学操作规程，也学应急预案，

shots.section_title: 人人培训：规程和应急
shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑上完成空白考试界面，出现对勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student completes a blank online test on a computer and a green check appears.
shots.narration: 考核合格，才能进实验室。

shots.section_title: 定期演练和复训
shots.scene: 王老师组织溢洒处置演练
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a spill response drill; students practise with a spill kit box with a blank label.
shots.narration: 第七，定期演练。

shots.section_title: 定期演练和复训
shots.scene: 日历上每隔一段时间出现一个循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a circular arrow icon appearing at regular intervals. No people.
shots.narration: 隔一段时间复训一次，

shots.section_title: 定期演练和复训
shots.scene: 老周和学生们一起听复训
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits with the students attending a refresher training session.
shots.narration: 老手也要复训，规程更新了更要学。

shots.section_title: 开工前、收工后，台面消毒
shots.scene: 小研用消毒剂擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the lab bench with disinfectant and paper towels, wearing gloves.
shots.narration: 习惯里还差关键一条。
overlay: 开工前、收工后，台面消毒

shots.section_title: 开工前、收工后，台面消毒
shots.scene: 两个时钟图标：开工、收工，中间是喷瓶
shots.prompt_en: Two clock icons for start and end of work, with a disinfectant spray bottle between them. No people.
shots.narration: 开工前、收工后，台面都要消毒，

shots.section_title: 开工前、收工后，台面消毒
shots.scene: 台面洒了一点培养液，小研立即覆盖纸巾
shots.prompt_en: A few drops of culture medium spill on the bench; the female graduate student immediately covers them with paper towels.
shots.narration: 洒了就按规程马上处理。

shots.section_title: 实验服：专用存放，先消毒再洗
shots.scene: 实验服挂在实验室门内专用衣钩上
shots.prompt_en: Lab coats hang on dedicated hooks just inside the lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服也有讲究。
overlay: 实验服：专用存放，先消毒再洗

shots.section_title: 实验服：专用存放，先消毒再洗
shots.scene: 实验服和日常外套挂在一起、带回宿舍的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat hanging together with an everyday jacket and a lab coat in a dorm room, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不和便服混放，不带回宿舍洗。

shots.section_title: 实验服：专用存放，先消毒再洗
shots.scene: 污染的实验服装进专用袋，送去消毒
shots.prompt_en: A contaminated lab coat is placed into a bag with a biohazard sign and sent for disinfection.
shots.narration: 沾了菌液，先消毒，再统一清洗。

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不能代替护目镜
shots.scene: 阿杰戴着近视眼镜，以为不用再戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing his ordinary glasses, shrugs as if goggles are unnecessary.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：我戴着眼镜，还要护目镜吗？
overlay: 近视眼镜不能代替护目镜

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不能代替护目镜
shots.scene: 液滴从普通眼镜侧面和上方溅进眼睛的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of droplets reaching the eye from the sides and top of ordinary glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 普通眼镜两侧和上方都有缝。

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不能代替护目镜
shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰能套在眼镜外面的护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student over-the-glasses safety goggles, and he puts them on.
shots.narration: 要戴能套在眼镜外的护目镜。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：实验服手套、洗手、讲台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three icons: a lab coat with gloves, washing hands, and a podium.
shots.narration: 防护穿戴对，鞋子要合适，

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 不吃喝、洗手、整洁台面、消毒四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: no food or drink, washing hands, a tidy bench, and a disinfectant spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 不吃喝、勤洗手、台面整洁常消毒，

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 阿杰穿戴整齐，台面整洁，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, fully dressed in lab coat, gloves and goggles at a tidy bench, gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 培训合格再进门，定期复训不能停。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣、阿杰、小研在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 好习惯护你平安，下次见！
